text:
Explicit review revision within this unexecuted planning session. Preserve the accepted requirements, sole query input, exact public output contracts, first at most ten observed products in their order, real individual product navigation, exact workbook destination and writer result, and root Browser cleanup. No requirements changes, permissions expansion, new operations beyond necessary data adaptation, or budget resets. This is a proposal for separate artifact approval, not execution authorization.

The current artifact is not ready for approval. Remove the unrequested detectConsentAndSearchState / acceptCookiesIfOffered / clickAcceptCookies work and its dependencies. The user requested search, product visits and Excel, not that interaction. Do not classify ordinary observed elements as blockers. Keep the actual complete search acquisition; the redundant current-page read may be removed if the unchanged initial acquisition provides its data. Genuine producer errors or incomplete acquisitions must fail explicitly before affected extraction, visits or writing, with cleanup retained.

Restructure only data adaptation using existing bindings. The current whole-snapshot extractProductLinks mixes extraction and global first-ten selection and asks source-grounded mapping to invent rank values. Instead retain original complete observations separately. Project record arrays per original page with one necessary typed foreach, export records, then flatten one level. Use existing observed selector identities; do not manufacture rank/index values in learned scripts. Extract independently over observationSnapshot.pages with explicit each, a closed resultType containing array<array<Candidate>> where each inner array contains only observed selector identity and observed decision text. Empty arrays mean that page was examined. Process every page; do not limit each page to ten candidates, synthesize null/error labels, deduplicate, exclude sponsored results or apply new ranking criteria. Give a global interpretation only flatten(extracted candidate arrays) and query, returning up to ten offered IDs in original order. Validate selections with lookup against offered candidates, project their IDs within item scope, then lookup those verified IDs against original records. Visits use the exact original href with a local nonnull assertion, not a model-generated URL. Repeated selections remain repeated.

Apply the same bounded complete-page extraction to product details. Do not pass whole snapshots or flat content to mapping or interpretation. Extract only observed name/description/price fact arrays from every page; empty fact arrays represent observed absence without invented scalar defaults. A compact interpretation may reconcile those exact facts to one nonnull product record with nullable missing name/description/price and explicit errors. Its inputs contain compact facts plus original product URL and original producer error metadata, not snapshots. Known typed fields and loop row assembly use direct typed bindings, never learned copying. Keep the explicit bounded TSV-formatting transform over at most ten compact records, preserving observed values and row order.

Add local boolean requires on consumers checking producer success and observationSnapshot presence, then captureTruncated=false and manifestTruncated=false on that same snapshot, in short-circuit order. Use the inspected contract's actual fields. Do not use a model-written boolean to prove completeness or cardinality. No empty/unusable page may become CAPTCHA, fabricated product data or successful empty work. Preserve public filePath from the actual successful writer; check success before reporting completion. completed must reflect successful required work and writer success, not the formatter's unverified claim.

Stay within existing TaskPlan syntax: field selects a declared object property, never an array; output already selects its port. each.input names a bound collection and each.output names its sole array result field. flatten takes exactly one typed nonnullable array-of-arrays; lookup takes record array then selected-ID array and literal identity port. Put plumbing directly in consumer bindings where possible; use only necessary typed projection loops. No scripts, new constructs or broader repair authority. Return the complete revised TaskPlan with unchanged accepted requirements.
